actions.description: Copy a presentation to a (possibly different) folder, optionally renaming it.
actions.name: copy-presentation

driveId.description: The ID of the drive containing the presentation to copy. Example: "b!..."

itemId.description: The ID of the presentation to copy. Example: "01RFYLAY..."

name.description: Optional new name for the copy. Example: "copy.pptx"

destinationDriveId.description: Optional ID of the destination drive. Defaults to the source drive if omitted. Requires destinationFolderId to also be set.

destinationFolderId.description: Optional ID of the destination folder. Defaults to the source folder if omitted.

id.description: The ID of the copied presentation. Only present when the API returns it synchronously.

name.description: The name of the copied presentation. Only present when the API returns it synchronously.

webUrl.description: The web URL of the copied presentation. Only present when the API returns it synchronously.

status.description: The copy status: "completed" for synchronous copies, "pending" for asynchronous copies.

monitorUrl.description: URL to poll for asynchronous copy progress. Only present when status is "pending".

actions.description: Upload a new .pptx presentation to a drive folder.
actions.name: create-presentation

parentId.description: Parent folder item ID. Omit to upload to the drive root.

filename.description: File name without the .pptx extension. Example: "my-presentation"

actions.description: Create a sharing link for a presentation.
actions.name: create-sharing-link

type.description: The type of sharing link to create.

scope.description: The scope of the sharing link.

itemId.description: Item ID of the presentation. Example: "01RFYLAY..."

actions.description: Download a presentation converted to PDF
actions.name: get-presentation-as-pdf

itemId.description: Item ID of the presentation. Example: "01RFYLAYBX27CGEGAJH5HZMVYI6Y3NGGYJ"

actions.description: Download the raw .pptx content of a presentation.
actions.name: get-presentation-content

actions.description: Retrieve driveItem metadata for a presentation
actions.name: get-presentation

driveId.description: The ID of the drive containing the presentation. Example: "b!PkCXTGMWc0aQ-tL4aQtFEDRX0SkZPfZDl2tD7OP_gahvi-nd5TAvTJG6KTmx6Mm0"

itemId.description: The ID of the driveItem representing the presentation. Example: "01RFYLAYBX27CGEGAJH5HZMVYI6Y3NGGYJ"

actions.description: Get the default document library (drive) for a SharePoint site.
actions.name: get-site-drive

userId.description: User ID or user principal name. Example: "test_api@nango.dev"

actions.description: List sharing permissions on a presentation.
actions.name: list-presentation-permissions

driveId.description: The ID of the drive containing the presentation. Example: b!PkCXTGMWc0aQ-tL4aQtFEDRX0SkZPfZDl2tD7OP_gahvi-nd5TAvTJG6KTmx6Mm0

itemId.description: The ID of the presentation item. Example: 01RFYLAYBX27CGEGAJH5HZMVYI6Y3NGGYJ

actions.description: Get thumbnail image URLs for a presentation.
actions.name: list-presentation-thumbnails

itemId.description: Item ID of the presentation. Example: "01RFYLAY..."

actions.description: List the version history of a presentation.
actions.name: list-presentation-versions

driveId.description: The ID of the drive containing the presentation. Example: "b!PkCXTGMWc0aQ-tL4aQtFEDRX0SkZPfZDl2tD7OP_gahvi-nd5TAvTJG6KTmx6Mm0"

itemId.description: The ID of the presentation item. Example: "01RFYLAYBX27CGEGAJH5HZMVYI6Y3NGGYJ"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

nextCursor.description: Pagination cursor to retrieve the next page of versions.

query.description: Search query string. Omit to list presentations in the root folder of the drive.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: Search/list SharePoint sites accessible to the app.
actions.name: list-sites

query.description: Search query to filter SharePoint sites. Example: "nango"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response (the @odata.nextLink URL). Omit for the first page.

next_cursor.description: URL to fetch the next page of results. Pass this value back as the cursor input.

actions.description: List/search tenant users, to resolve a user id for personal OneDrive access.
actions.name: list-users

search.description: Search string to filter users by display name or email.

top.description: Number of users to return per page. Maximum 999.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (odata.nextLink) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: Move a presentation to a different folder.
actions.name: move-presentation

itemId.description: Item ID of the presentation to move. Example: "01RFYLAY..."

destinationFolderId.description: Item ID of the destination folder. Example: "01RFYLAY..."

actions.description: Replace the content of an existing presentation.
actions.name: update-presentation-content

driveId.description: The ID of the drive containing the presentation. Example: "b!PkCXTGMW..."

itemId.description: The ID of the presentation item to update. Example: "01RFYLAYBX27CGEGAJH5HZMVYI6Y3NGGYJ"

content.description: The binary content of the presentation as a base64-encoded string.

contentType.description: The MIME type of the content. Defaults to "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation".

actions.description: Rename a presentation or update its description, without touching content
actions.name: update-presentation-metadata

name.description: New name for the presentation. Omit to keep unchanged.

description.description: New description for the presentation. Pass null to clear.
